final_text:
Done. The pricing section is built and verified.

## What I added
A `#pricing` section inserted directly below the hero (between "Generate CSS as you code" and "Why teams choose BaroCSS"), styled entirely with BaroCSS utility classes to match the site's existing design language (`max-w-7xl` container, `rounded-2xl` cards, slate/blue palette).

- **Three plan cards** in a responsive `md:grid-cols-3` grid, each with a name, price (`$0` / `$12` / `$29` per mo), a check-marked feature list, and a CTA button:
  - **Free** → "Get started"
  - **Pro** → "Start Pro trial"
  - **Team** → "Contact sales"
- **Pro highlighted as recommended:** a "Recommended" pill badge on top, a filled blue→indigo gradient background with inverted white text, a solid white CTA, a heavier `shadow-2xl`, and a `-mt-4` lift so it stands proud of its neighbors.

## Verification & adjustments
I used the BaroCSS resolution reports and computed styles to catch and fix things that don't work on this page:
- **`-translate-x-1/2`** produced a broken transform (undefined `--baro-translate-y`), so I re-centered the badge with a full-width `flex justify-center` wrapper instead.
- **`ring-1`** and the bare **`shadow`** utility reference custom properties this page never defines, so I dropped them (`shadow` → `shadow-md`).
- I discovered **borders render invisible sitewide** (no preflight sets `border-style: solid` — even the site's own cards compute to `border-style: none`) and **`scale-*` yields `transform: none`**. Since a blue border/scale wouldn't have shown, I switched the Pro highlight to the filled gradient treatment, which I confirmed renders (gradient background, white text, white button, translucent check chips all resolve).

Console shows 0 errors. The section renders as intended.

- **Three plan cards** in a responsive `md:grid-cols-3` grid, each with a name, price (`$0` / `$12` / `$29` per mo), a check-marked feature list, and a CTA button:
  - **Free** → "Get started"
  - **Pro** → "Start Pro trial"
  - **Team** → "Contact sales"
- **Pro highlighted as recommended:** a "Recommended" pill badge on top, a filled blue→indigo gradient background with inverted white text, a solid white CTA, a heavier `shadow-2xl`, and a `-mt-4` lift so it stands proud of its neighbors.

## Verification & adjustments
I used the BaroCSS resolution reports and computed styles to catch and fix things that don't work on this page:
- **`-translate-x-1/2`** produced a broken transform (undefined `--baro-translate-y`), so I re-centered the badge with a full-width `flex justify-center` wrapper instead.
- **`ring-1`** and the bare **`shadow`** utility reference custom properties this page never defines, so I dropped them (`shadow` → `shadow-md`).
- I discovered **borders render invisible sitewide** (no preflight sets `border-style: solid` — even the site's own cards compute to `border-style: none`) and **`scale-*` yields `transform: none`**. Since a blue border/scale wouldn't have shown, I switched the Pro highlight to the filled gradient treatment, which I confirmed renders (gradient background, white text, white button, translucent check chips all resolve).

Console shows 0 errors. The section renders as intended.
